scope: Advisory fixed20-block affected P3 portfolio, all adverse observations retained. Independent immutable-batch-pipe event; base already has immutable copies and bounded worker reuse. No pooling with earlier immutable-copy events. Default host policy, not controlled release acceptance. Go managed/LLGo collector bytes differ, and Go counters exclude Rust/JIT allocation. Native-Go is an ordinary application control, not an optimized native lower bound.
